_comment: Copy to secrets.json in the same folder as config.json (paths.secrets_file) and fill in. Never commit the real file: it is in .gitignore and this repo is public. Restrict it with icacls to the task account and Administrators. Environment variables win over this file: MM_USERNAME + MM_PASSWORD, CTS_ALARMS_INGEST_SECRET.

vps._comment: Only needed once config.json has a "vps" section. Same value as CTS_ALARMS_INGEST_SECRET in the digibuild cts-alarms worker's env file on the VPS.
